about_short_description.short_description: DillX is a SaaS-based legal tech platform that automates investment due diligence to mitigate risk and maximize returns.

product.name: DillX Due Diligence Automation Platform
product.description: A SaaS platform that automates investment due diligence, generating detailed reports with pre-verified company data and risk alerts within three days.

product.name: Virtual Data Room Due Diligence
product.description: An online secure repository for storing and sharing confidential documents during transactions, enabling remote due diligence with controlled access and real-time monitoring.

product.name: Due Diligence Audit Service
product.description: A comprehensive evaluation process assessing a company’s financial, legal, operational, HR, and tax status to identify risks and validate data before transactions.

product.name: Technology Assessment in Due Diligence
product.description: A systematic evaluation of a company’s technology infrastructure, software, and cybersecurity to identify risks and growth opportunities during due diligence.
